mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies over the Verona Area High School with the temperature at 55 degrees. The moon is in a waxing crescent phase, and the overnight low will hit 48 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Regarding city news, officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way on September 10th following reports of a burglary. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was taken into custody after a brief incident involving a firearm, and he will face charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival on Main Street. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company this weekend, join in for yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, or test your knowledge at trivia nights starting this Monday.

On September 10th, the Verona Police Department responded to a burglary in progress at a residence on Hunter's Cove Way where a handgun was recovered, and the suspect was taken to a hospital for treatment.
